tool_args.rationale: The existing observations vary both current input and sink gradient, and their signatures support a static two-layer siphon rather than a slow-horizon or coupled-memory mechanism. Fit the documented square-root and linear-leak branch alternatives numerically to the five paid rows and let fresh confirmation assess the selected fit; no additional probe is justified by the observed gradient span.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Sink gradient already spans 0.25 to 2.2, well above the supplied <0.08 trigger for this probe; fit the competing branch forms against the existing rows.
The observed signatures are monotone-concave and the target horizon is only 0.6; the documented ODE families are not indicated.
This is explicitly irrelevant to distinguishing the supported siphon branches and is not worth its cost.

considered_alternatives.option: Static quadratic or single-factor Michaelis-Menten models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied signatures include sink-gradient dependence, which these alternatives omit.
